title: Rooms
body: In a room you hear when someone mentions you and when your own turns finish while you’re away. Choose more or less for each room in its ⋯ menu, under Notify me about.

presence.label: Show when I’m in a room
presence.hint: The room’s members see your avatar while you have it open. Turn this off to look without showing.
presence.shown: Rooms show when you’re in them
